entries.title: II Chronicles 32:1
segments: ¶After these deeds of faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Assyria came and entered Judah; he encamped against the fortified cities, thinking to win them over to himself.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:2
segments: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come, and that his purpose was to make war against Jerusalem,

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:3
segments: he consulted with his leaders and commanders to stop the water from the springs which [were] outside the city; and they helped him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:4
segments: Thus many people gathered together who stopped all the springs and the brook that ran through the land, saying, "Why should the kings of Assyria come and find much water?"

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:5
segments: And he strengthened himself, built up all the wall that was broken, raised [it] up to the towers, and [built] another wall outside; also he repaired the Millo [in] the City of David, and made weapons and shields in abundance.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:6
segments: Then he set military captains over the people, gathered them together to him in the open square of the city gate, and gave them encouragement, saying,

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:7
segments: "Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid nor dismayed before the king of Assyria, nor before all the multitude that [is] with him; for [there are] more with us than with him.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:8
segments: "With him [is] an arm of flesh; but with us [is] the LORD our God, to help us and to fight our battles." And the people were strengthened by the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:9
segments: ¶After this Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem (but he and all the forces with him [laid siege] against Lachish), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who [were] in Jerusalem, saying,

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:10
segments: "Thus says Sennacherib king of Assyria: 'In what do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:11
segments: 'Does not Hezekiah persuade you to give yourselves over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, "The LORD our God will deliver us from the hand of the king of Assyria"?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:12
segments: 'Has not the same Hezekiah taken away His high places and His altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, "You shall worship before one altar and burn incense on it"?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:13
segments: 'Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of [other] lands? Were the gods of the nations of those lands in any way able to deliver their lands out of my hand?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:14
segments: 'Who [was there] among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people from my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you from my hand?

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:15
segments: 'Now therefore, do not let Hezekiah deceive you or persuade you like this, and do not believe him; for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people from my hand or the hand of my fathers. How much less will your God deliver you from my hand?'"

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:16
segments: Furthermore, his servants spoke against the LORD God and against His servant Hezekiah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:17
segments: He also wrote letters to revile the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against Him, saying, "As the gods of the nations of [other] lands have not delivered their people from my hand, so the God of Hezekiah will not deliver His people from my hand."

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:18
segments: Then they called out with a loud voice in Hebrew to the people of Jerusalem who [were] on the wall, to frighten them and trouble them, that they might take the city.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:19
segments: And they spoke against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth-the work of men's hands.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:20
segments: Now because of this King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah, the son of Amoz, prayed and cried out to heaven.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:21
segments: Then the LORD sent an angel who cut down every mighty man of valor, leader, and captain in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned shamefaced to his own land. And when he had gone into the temple of his god, some of his own offspring struck him down with the sword there.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:22
segments: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all [others], and guided them on every side.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:23
segments: And many brought gifts to the LORD at Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah, so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations thereafter.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:24
segments: ¶In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death, and he prayed to the LORD; and He spoke to him and gave him a sign.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:25
segments: But Hezekiah did not repay according to the favor [shown] him, for his heart was lifted up; therefore wrath was looming over him and over Judah and Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:26
segments: Then Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD did not come upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:27
segments: Hezekiah had very great riches and honor. And he made himself treasuries for silver, for gold, for precious stones, for spices, for shields, and for all kinds of desirable items;

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:28
segments: storehouses for the harvest of grain, wine, and oil; and stalls for all kinds of livestock, and folds for flocks.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:29
segments: Moreover he provided cities for himself, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him very much property.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:30
segments: This same Hezekiah also stopped the water outlet of Upper Gihon, and brought the water by tunnel to the west side of the City of David. Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:31
segments: However, [regarding] the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, whom they sent to him to inquire about the wonder that was [done] in the land, God withdrew from him, in order to test him, that He might know all [that was] in his heart.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:32
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, indeed they [are] written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, [and] in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 32:33
segments: So Hezekiah rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the upper tombs of the sons of David; and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. Then Manasseh his son reigned in his place.
